spots.name: Mount Huntington
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below.

spots.name: Byers Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to Denali SP: Byers Lake on the shore.

spots.name: Denali SP*
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 139 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L295787.

spots.name: Pittock Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Goose Creek Tower
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented. Mapped as private or no access: check before you go.
